maldăcon , i, n.,
I.the gum of the tree called bdellium: “vicina est Bactriana, in qua bdellium nom inatissimum. Arbor nigra est ... gummi alii brochon appellant, alii malacham, alii maldacon,” Plin. 12, 9, 19, § 35 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
